en-US.name: Motrix Media Merge
en-US.description: Combine separate video and audio files into one MP4 or MKV without re-encoding. An optional official plugin, installed separately.
features: Choose a video, an audio file, and where to save the merged file
Copy the original tracks into MP4 or MKV without re-encoding
Open the Operations tab or select two completed single-file downloads
See progress, cancel a merge, and inspect its activity in plugin logs
Requires configured FFmpeg and Motrix 2.0.0-beta.48 or later (below 3.0.0) with plugin operations v1; installed separately

zh-CN.name: Motrix 音视频合并
zh-CN.description: 将分离的视频和音频合成为一个 MP4 或 MKV 文件，无需重新编码。官方维护，按需安装。
features: 选择视频、音频和保存位置，即可手动合并
直接复制原始轨道，支持 MP4 和 MKV 输出
从插件的“操作”页进入，或选中两个已完成的单文件下载
查看合并进度、取消操作，并通过插件日志排查问题
需要配置 FFmpeg，并使用支持插件操作 v1 的 Motrix 2.0.0-beta.48 及以上版本（低于 3.0.0）；默认不随应用安装
